👷Welcome to Mining Inc Remastered!
an exciting team-based game set in the depths of the mine.

Whether you choose to take on the role of a skilled miner drilling tunnels, a hauler collecting precious minerals, or a forklift driver transporting crates to the ship, every player has a unique and vital role to play in this thrilling adventure.

With randomly generated terrain in each round, every game presents a new challenge and opportunity for exploration. But the key to success lies in teamwork, as you work together with your fellow miners to overcome obstacles and maximise your haul.

Get ready to experience the thrill of the mine in this exciting adventure, where each player's contribution is essential to your success.

Play Mining Inc Remastered today!
